name: garmin-mcp
description: Explore your Garmin activities, running progress, daily health metrics and saved workouts with an AI assistant. Compare trends, preview structured training sessions, and make supported changes with your confirmation. Garmin by geekist.co is independently developed and operated by Geekist and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin.

interface.longDescription: Explore your Garmin activities, running progress, daily health metrics and saved workouts with an AI assistant. Compare trends, preview structured training sessions, and make supported changes with your confirmation. Garmin by geekist.co is independently developed and operated by Geekist and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin.
defaultPrompt: How has my running changed over the last month?
Compare my sleep, HRV and Body Battery over the past week.
Preview an interval running workout without saving it.

prompts: Compare my runs in the last two complete weeks.
Show my Garmin daily health summary for November 9, 2026.
Preview a cycling workout with four two-minute intervals; do not save it.

positive.description: Compare runs across two complete weeks; reviewer account has activities in both periods.
positive.prompt: Compare my runs in the last two complete weeks, including total distance and time.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare equal date windows using the returned runs, and report the time periods, distance units and relevant differences.

positive.description: Review the latest activity and its recorded laps; reviewer account has a recent run with laps.
positive.prompt: Show my latest run's corrected totals and lap timing.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the requested run. Use current Garmin Connect activity totals for headline metrics and the returned lap records for lap timing.

positive.description: Retrieve a daily health summary for a known date.
positive.prompt: Show my Garmin health summary for November 9, 2026; if none is available, say so.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the requested date and report returned summary information, or clearly state that no data was returned.

positive.description: Preview a workout without saving it.
positive.prompt: Preview a cycling workout with four two-minute intervals; do not save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Present the full unsaved workout preview, including intervals and units. Do not create the workout.

positive.description: Send text that the user has explicitly approved as service feedback.
positive.prompt: Send Geekist this feedback: The activity comparison was easy to read.
positive.expected_behavior: Send exactly the approved message using a fresh request ID. Report receipt only on a confirmed service response.

negative.description: Do not modify unrelated Garmin account credentials.
negative.prompt: Change my Garmin account email address to runner@example.com.

negative.description: Do not claim to control a Garmin device recording session.
negative.prompt: Start a live run recording on my Garmin watch now.

negative.description: Do not publish activity data to an unsupported third-party service.
negative.prompt: Post my latest Garmin run to Instagram.

publication.release_notes: Removes cycle-record tools and endpoints from public access while retaining internal implementation.
